newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's 48-hr peso dips marginally at close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's 48-hr peso dips marginally at close.

text.p: Mexico's benchmark 48-hour peso closed marginally lower Wednesday in a session dominated by early speculative presures that evaporated, dealers said.
The 48-peso contract ended off 0.35 centavo at 7.9230/7.9265 per dollar. Its 24-hour stablemate closed down 0.2 centavo at 7.9190/7.9210 per dollar.
"In the morning we had plenty of pressure and then the peso came back," one dealer said. "It was pure speculation."
Jitters were blamed on the outcome of the upcoming key mid-term elections scheduled for July 6.

Also adding pressures, dealers said, were the prospect of U.S. rate movements stemming from the July 2 meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee and also unemployment data expected in the United States this Friday.
Mexico's same-day peso closed down 1.5 centavo to 7.9180/7.9210 per dollar.
